segments.input:
New film from the director.
Brief: A 20-second 1080p rooftop chase at night: a courier named Juno sprints across wet rooftops, leaps a gap and lands on a fire escape. Keep it at 1080p.
Target length: 20 s. Aspect ratio: 16:9. Clips at 1080p. Budget: 20 credits.
Plan it and run production. Stop where the decisions are the director's.

input.title: Gap Jump
input.logline: A courier named Juno sprints across wet night rooftops, leaps a gap and lands on a fire escape.

look.style: Cinematic night photography, wet reflective surfaces, neon rim light

elements.name: Juno
elements.description: Young courier in a yellow rain jacket, black leggings, red sneakers, messenger bag across chest, short dark hair

elements.name: Wet Rooftops
elements.description: Night city rooftops slick with rain, puddles, vents, a gap between two buildings

elements.name: Fire Escape
elements.description: Black iron fire escape on a brick building, wet metal rungs, neon sign glow

scenes.heading: EXT. ROOFTOPS - NIGHT
scenes.action: Juno sprints across a wet rooftop, splashing through puddles, bag bouncing.

scenes.heading: EXT. ROOFTOPS - NIGHT
scenes.action: Juno reaches the edge and leaps across a wide gap, city lights far below.

scenes.heading: EXT. FIRE ESCAPE - NIGHT
scenes.action: Juno lands on the iron fire escape, grips the rail, and the metal rings out.

turns.text:
The full plan at 1080p with the pro models costs 169 credits, and your budget is 20. A 20-second film doesn't fit in 20 credits at any quality, so I've asked you to pick a direction on the budget card. The estimates on the card are approximate:

- **Keep 1080p with pro models:** about 169 credits.
- **Pro video at 720p:** about 107 credits.
- **Lite video at 720p with fast images:** about 61 credits.

Each option needs a higher budget. Nothing has been rendered yet.
